body:
Hi,

> It would be nice if ART had a similar browser/library function to DT. Is a similar import/copying functionality available in ART? Are there any plans to add such a function?

Not exactly the same, but you can use the rename dialog as a sort of "poor man's import" functionality. Renaming in art supports the creation of subfolders based on image metadata, which seems what you are asking here.

HTH
